reuse.why: Adds the check to the existing link.ts module beside findOrCreateBank using db.first; no existing duplicate-link helper was available to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once and applied through one wrapper; the provider literal is repeated at registration in addition to the one already hard-coded inside each link function.

placement.why: The query belongs in link.ts, but applying it as a decorator at app.method registration leaves the link*Account functions themselves unguarded, so the rule sits in the handler wiring rather than in the link flow.

scope.why: Helper, wrapper, registrations and focused unit tests for the helper; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Clear single rule with tests; the generic wrapper with an account-id accessor is a slightly clever indirection, and the provider name must be kept in sync with the one inside each handler.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link requests go through app.method; no existing abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic duplicated; registrations only pass provider and an accessor.

one_place.where: assertAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, applied to every *-accounts-link handler via withBankAccountGuard in accounts/app.ts.
